propositions: Jira Cloud uses opaque accountId for user identity while Data Center uses name, requiring a pluggable contract to handle both correctly
PR #120 hardcoded is_account_id=False and used unreachable getattr-based resolver discovery, causing Data Center to always return authoritative=False and emit perpetual assignee-change churn

UserIdentityModel protocol must provide resolve(local_value, remote_identity) returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) tuple and to_payload(value) returning deployment-specific assignee field shape
NameIdentity implementation must perform real lookup against Data Center user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees, stopping diff churn
An unresolvable assignee must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning non-authoritative state for both implementations
